name: The Choices Of Priori
detailed_description:
About this game:

“The choices of Priori” is an exploration RPG with many elements.

The story begins in a city called "Overtime City", you play as a frail teenager, starting from an empty room, uncover a mysterious black cloth, you explore a vast underground lab, and find strange creatures called KB-Cats, they plot a revolutionary uprising, with them you finally reach to the "Path to freedom". In this forever daytime world, you’ll meet   many vivid companions. Together, you’ll think and explore the theme” work or die”, with their help, you’ll make your choices, chase the truth and survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.

Game Features: 

  • [Storyline] – Drive the plot forward through exploration, survival, and management elements. No tedious puzzles or cryptic riddles—just imaginative citizens of Overtime City and the adorable magical creature, KB-Cat, ready to chat with you about anything under the sun.

  • [Systems] – Even staying still increases your fatigue. The protagonist’s fragile physique will teach you the meaning of "Work or die"—you must work desperately to earn money and recover stamina... right? Morality, mood, sanity, hunger, illness, and many other mechanics affect your survival. Staying alive is no easy feat!

  • [Working] – Idle gameplay, adventuring, part-time jobs, scavenging... Here, you can earn cash through all sorts of methods. Improve yourself, try different professions and approaches, and experience the allure of money in this city. Work hard—then buy everything!

  • [Exploration] – In Overtime City, endless possibilities lurk in every corner. The secrets hidden in unnoticed places may shock you. Journey from the real world to the spiritual realm, uncover the truth behind this world, collect the seven types of "Kiri-Stars" imbued with extraordinary powers—and then change the world.

  • [Characters] – Lively little animals, elegant and intellectual girls, brawny vegetables, eerie demons… You’ll never know what strange residents call Overtime City home. But among them, you’re bound to meet the right companion for your adventures—so write a heartwarming story together!

【Localization Notice】

As this game is independently developed by a single creator, the localization process (especially for large volumes of text) will unavoidably progress slowly. Some languages may currently lack full translation coverage, please stay tuned for future updates!

——— Nano0

Join their uprising, survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.
